result:
All 75 pass.

Root cause: `supersede()` docstring claim false. Old decision's `status` stays ACTIVE on disk forever (append-only, never rewritten); nothing anywhere followed `supersedes` chain to reclassify it on read. So `decisions()` leaked stale decisions as active, and `check_decision_resurfacing` (filters on `status in (REJECTED, SUPERSEDED)`) never saw superseded decisions, silently disabling resurfacing detection for every superseded decision.

Fix: `decisions()` in `src/verityai/memory/store.py:162` now computes the set of ids targeted by any `supersedes` field and reclassifies those records SUPERSEDED at read time (still append-only, no rewrite). Added regression test `test_a_superseded_decision_is_reclassified_on_read` in `tests/unit/test_memory.py`.
